slice: exploring: eight legs, crawling, hovering, darting

items.sentence: Co-linear is two moves with one between, each bringing a prior forward, a line both share, in neither alone, and an abundancing making itself there.
items.text: A wandering spider on a vibrating floor is turning toward the legs a vibration reaches first, an onset 4 ms apart being enough, or toward the legs it reaches with larger amplitude; a front leg's changing is quieting the legs behind it on its own side, and with both sides changing this quieting is going front to back alone; its turning is less exact as the source is further behind it.

Eight legs are three binaries, left or right across, front or back along, and first or not first in sequence, two to the third being eight: each leg is opening with its prior and the parity it is observing, a leg and its partner across are agreeing or parting now, and the spider's turning is its next, five dimensions resolving in two directions, a vibration coming inward along the legs and the spider's turning going outward, its direction resolving by the sequence of its legs' changing and by no magnitude; whether amplitude is meeting this sequence is still-possibling.

items.sentence: Patterning is co-chaining along, position to position, a sequence a method rides, each pattern a relating already showing that a method co-chains further.
items.text: A desert ant walking out and homing is going by its strides: with stilts on its legs it is overshooting its home, with its legs cut short it is stopping short, its stride rate and speed barely changing, its going a sequence of strides.

items.section: 1.1 In disequilibria, changing and changing back is a stable-forming method
items.sentence: A self is observing from its own side.
items.text: A hovering hummingbird is holding its place at a feeder to within millimetres by holding the world's image motion still about it; when a background pattern is moving, it is drifting about a centimetre with it, and time to adapt is leaving the drifting in place.

A fruit fly is exploring by straight flights and sudden turns, each turn about 90 degrees in under 50 ms, all or none, left or right; an expanding image ahead is opening a turn, an attractive odour is changing how often and where turns come, and its balance organs are signalling the counter-turn ending each.

items.sentence: Geodesic goes with a method no force bends, a way it discovers where a forcing way confirms.
items.text: A hunting dragonfly is catching its prey about 95 times in 100, in under half a second from its perch, its head turning with the prey's image ahead of the image's drifting, and its body turning with its head, many of its turns coming with no change in the prey's flight; a field's explaining of internal models stands apart from this observing.

items.sentence: A method observes what a sensing returns, valuable and wasteful together, sorting neither.
items.text: An octopus has two thirds of its neurons in its eight arms, each arm with thousands of suckers moving on their own; a sucker's taste cells are signalling all through a touching, its touch cells only at a touching's opening, and an arm is tasting partly on its own.

A spider at the centre of its eight legs, a vibration reaching one leg first and the spider turning to it, three binaries drawing eight directions; and a fly's path of straight flights and sudden all-or-none turns, a geodesic snapping.
